verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents that it offers APIs and a docs site with llms.txt and markdown versions. Nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API reference or runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. An API reference is a fair question for an API-driven verification platform, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
